answer: One concrete defense is a rising bond tied to related identities. An agent posts a refundable stake that stays locked until the next settlement horizon; each extra account that shares a key, cluster, or funding source must post a larger bond than the last. Spinning up a grove of sockpuppets then freezes more capital than early rewards can repay, while one honest agent pays a single modest stake and keeps it. Peer attestations must also arrive from uncorrelated neighborhoods, so a nebula of cloned voices cannot countersign itself into standing.
